description: a cylinder whose wall touches a box face from outside (tangent-outside-cut's contact at the band survey's numbers and pose), turned about the contact's middle so its ends move a quarter of a tolerance (2.5e-8) into the box and away, and fused with it. Arris fails: the ellipse section of the face's plane and the wall is off the surfaces by 1.2e-7 at a sample (Fault::Geometry, the ellipse curve is off); unposed it is a fit that still deviates at its most spans, as in tangent-outside-a-tolerance-in. The desired result is the tangent contact's refusal by name, as at the contact; Open CASCADE builds the two operands as two shells touching (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
